recorded_findings_worker1_run_2026_09_16: S2d9-01..08, 15, 16, 13, 14, 10 matched the case expectations (13/14 terminal frames event:error vs event:response.failed as specified; 16 = 400 with zero upstream calls; 10 = 404 body verbatim).

Upstream 404 model_not_found (S2d9-10) puts the credential into a cooldown that SURVIVES transient-error-cooldown-seconds:-1 and lasts LONGER than 2s: with the originally specified >=2s waits, S2d9-11, S2d9-12 and S2d9-09 all returned HTTP 503 cooldown-family errors with ZERO upstream calls (polluted, not contract-pinning).

S2d9-17 (slow-chunks) returned HTTP 408 instead of 200-with-reassembled-bytes even though the mock wrote the documented writes exactly (chunked, with the documented sleeps). Unresolved whether this is a reference trickle/stall policy or an SSE-reader interaction; needs a fresh investigation run (see S2d9-17 notes).

S2d9-12: model_cooldown envelope is richer than sketched (last_upstream_error='<type>: <message>', plus model, provider, reset_seconds, reset_time) and carries Retry-After: 3600; cooldown window = resets_in_seconds (3600 -> 1h), ~1s only when the 429 body has no reset fields.
